operations.hypothesis: Return the exact normalized finite vertex carrier.

operations.name: incidence_matrix
operations.hypothesis: Build the exact vertex-by-edge zero-one incidence matrix.

operations.name: vertex_degrees
operations.hypothesis: Count exact incident-edge degrees for every declared vertex.

operations.name: pair_codegrees
operations.hypothesis: Count exact shared-edge codegrees for unordered vertex pairs.

operations.name: induced_vertex_subhypergraph
operations.hypothesis: Restrict every edge to a declared focus set and normalize nonempty results.

operations.name: edge_restriction
operations.hypothesis: Select exact edges wholly contained in a declared focus set.

operations.name: primal_graph
operations.hypothesis: Construct the exact two-section graph from shared hyperedges.

operations.name: line_graph
operations.hypothesis: Construct the exact edge-intersection graph.

operations.name: berge_components
operations.hypothesis: Compute finite vertex components under shared-edge reachability.

operations.name: transversal_enumeration
operations.hypothesis: Enumerate all inclusion-minimal finite hitting sets.

operations.name: minimum_transversals
operations.hypothesis: Select minimum-cardinality transversals from the exact finite enumeration.

operations.name: independent_set_enumeration
operations.hypothesis: Enumerate inclusion-maximal vertex sets containing no full hyperedge.

operations.name: matching_enumeration
operations.hypothesis: Enumerate inclusion-maximal pairwise-disjoint edge families.

operations.name: maximum_matchings
operations.hypothesis: Select maximum-cardinality pairwise-disjoint edge families.

operations.name: exact_cover_enumeration
operations.hypothesis: Enumerate edge families that partition the declared vertex carrier exactly.

operations.name: dual_hypergraph
operations.hypothesis: Transpose the finite incidence relation while preserving explicit labels.

operations.name: blocker_projection
operations.hypothesis: Represent the minimal-transversal family without claiming a general complexity theorem.

operations.name: hypergraph_external_observation_gap
operations.hypothesis: Keep real workshop observations and affected-user evaluation absent and open.

operations.name: hypergraph_governance_authority_gate
